text_block_list.text: The day of the Kikuka Sho has finally arrived—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Today, Rice won't let Bourbon-san pull away from her!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Keep up with them... until the very end.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'll catch up, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah.
I'm off...!

—Suddenly, memories of the Japanese Derby
flash through my mind.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Bour-bon! Bour-bon!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "What incredible cheers! Even before the start, shouts anticipating the birth of a champion echo across the venue!"

"...Even one more cheer
should be a great help to Rice Shower."
(Wooooaaaah---!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Don't give up, Bourbon!
Go for it too, Rice!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, this year's Kikuka Sho.
Which Umamusume will seize the Chrysanthemum glory?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The "Chestnut Super Express," Mihono Bourbon!
The "Jet-Black Stayer," Rice Shower!
These legendary Umamusume are ready to clash!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Do your best, Rice-chan!
Run all the way to the end, okay!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: D-Do your best...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
No, no!
Louder this time! Ready, go!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Rice Showeeer!!
Do your beeest!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Rice-chan's Trainer!
Hellooo!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: H-Hello...!
(Standing there were Haru Urara and... Zenno Rob Roy. If I recall correctly, she's... Rice Shower's roommate.)

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, we're Rice-chan's cheering squad!
Right, Rob Roy-chan?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! Rice has really been
giving it her all lately, so...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I thought it might be nice
to cheer for you properly at the racetrack."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And that's why we came together!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... my cheering might not amount to much,
but I'll support you with all my heart!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Let's do it one more time!
Here we go, ready... go!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Rice-chan, do your beeest!!
Rice-san, keep it up!!
And amidst the resounding cheers, the Kikuka Sho was about to begin—!
